verdict.rationale: Extend's parsing docs list table handling ('Agentic OCR and tables'), and the pricing page claims table detection, so the product does parse tables. Nothing shows that merged cells, nested headers or multi-page tables are preserved, or that output comes as HTML or markdown. missing for 10: documented merged-cell/rowspan-colspan preservation, nested header handling, cross-page table stitching, explicit HTML/markdown table output format, independent or hands-on corroboration of table fidelity.

support.subject: As a data engineer, complex tables — merged cells, nested headers, multi-page spans — come out as faithful HTML/markdown structure
